pr_title: [CI] support daily image and A5 build
source_quote: To prevent transient network failures from failing the build immediately or hanging indefinitely, it is recommended to add `--tries=3` and `--connect-timeout=10` to the `wget` command. Additionally, adding `-q` or `--no-verbose` keeps the build logs clean.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha c6e124b 体现修改

rule.description: Dockerfile 中使用 `wget`/`curl` 下载构建依赖时，须配置重试次数（`--tries`）、连接超时（`--timeout`/`--connect-timeout`）、重试等待（`--waitretry`）及连接拒绝重试（`--retry-connrefused`），避免瞬时网络故障导致构建立即失败或 CI 无限挂起。
checkpoints: 检查 Dockerfile 中 `wget`/`curl` 是否缺少 `--tries` 与超时参数
大体积依赖下载建议抽离为共享 shell 脚本统一维护

antipattern.code:
FROM ${CANN_QUAY_URL}/${CANN_VERSION}-${BASE_OS} AS daily-builder

ARG TORCH_NPU_VERSION
ARG TORCH_NPU_DATE

RUN if [ "$BUILD_TYPE" = "daily" ]; then \
        mkdir -p /tmp/torch_npu && \
        wget -O /tmp/torch_npu/torch_npu.tar.gz \
            "https://pytorch-package.obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/pta/Daily/v2.10.0-${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}/${TORCH_NPU_DATE}/pytorch_v2.10.0-${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}_py312.tar.gz" && \
        tar -xzf /tmp/torch_npu/torch_npu.tar.gz -C /tmp/torch_npu && \
        python3 -m pip install /tmp/torch_npu/*.whl --force-reinstall --no-deps && \
        rm -rf /tmp/torch_npu; \
    fi
antipattern.context: Dockerfile L110-125（其余 7 个 Dockerfile 结构相同）

pattern.code:
#!/bin/bash
# .github/workflows/scripts/install_daily_deps.sh
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$BUILD_TYPE" != "daily" ]; then exit 0; fi

mkdir -p /tmp/torch_npu
wget --retry-connrefused --tries=5 --timeout=30 --waitretry=10 \
    -O /tmp/torch_npu/torch_npu.tar.gz \
    "https://pytorch-package.obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/pta/Daily/v2.10.0-${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}/${TORCH_NPU_DATE}/pytorch_v2.10.0-${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}_py312.tar.gz"
tar -xzf /tmp/torch_npu/torch_npu.tar.gz -C /tmp/torch_npu
python3 -m pip install /tmp/torch_npu/*.whl --force-reinstall --no-deps
rm -rf /tmp/torch_npu
